content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"Three finance-sector programmes combine basic banking, life insurance, and accident insurance as follows: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) provides basic banking through Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts (BSBDA) and small accounts without minimum balance requirements [E02]. The Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) offers life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason, with a premium of ₹436 per annum, available to account holders aged 18-50 years [E01]. The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) provides accident insurance covering accidental death and disability with a premium of ₹20 per annum, available to account holders aged 18-70 years [E03]. Together, these three schemes integrate banking access, life insurance protection, and accident insurance coverage for eligible individuals through their bank and post office accounts.","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02","E03"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"PMJDY provides basic banking through BSBDA and small accounts without minimum balance requirements","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"PMJJBY offers life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason with premium of ₹436 per annum for account holders aged 18-50 years","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"PMSBY provides accident insurance covering accidental death and disability with premium of ₹20 per annum for account holders aged 18-70 years","evidence_ids":["E03"]}]}
